raw_translation: Ingiza ZXQPH0000QXZ- au ZXQPH0001QXZ-digit hex thamani, na au bila #, au kutumia rangi picker. Sahihi CSS jina rangi ni alama tofauti. Matokeo mengine ni majina ya karibu kiwango na perceptual OKLab umbali; wao ni approximations, si majina ya kimataifa.
source: Enter a 3- or 6-digit hex value, with or without #, or use the color picker. Exact CSS named colors are marked separately. Other results are the closest standard names by perceptual OKLab distance; they are approximations, not universal names.
translation: Ingiza 3- au 6-digit hex thamani, na au bila #, au kutumia rangi picker. Sahihi CSS jina rangi ni alama tofauti. Matokeo mengine ni majina ya karibu kiwango na perceptual OKLab umbali; wao ni approximations, si majina ya kimataifa.

back_sample.translation: Alignment is not firm. Choose images with more firm details and mix.

raw_translation: Alignment si imara. Chagua picha na maelezo zaidi imara na mchanganyiko.
source: The alignment is unstable. Choose photos with more fixed detail and overlap.
translation: Alignment si imara. Chagua picha na maelezo zaidi imara na mchanganyiko.
